name: hstar_bench-SR
description:
H* Bench Super-Resolution
	

This is the dataset created from https://huggingface.co/datasets/humanoid-vstar/hstar_bench, using SR tools to recover the .jpg files to high-resolution .png files.
Notice: The result may be different to which presented in out paper!
evaluation_method: PSNR / SSIM / LPIPS (common image super-resolution metrics)
general_score_metric: PSNR (primary reported metric for SR quality)
reputation: A niche variant of the H* Bench created to test super-resolution recovery of original images; mainly of interest to researchers working on dataset reconstruction and SR methods.
